title: Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Rate Sheet and Credit Tier Bands
content:
**Dealer Rate Sheet — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

Every Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract is booked on one of six credit tiers, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 through Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+. Each tier admits a band of credit scores (FICO Auto Score 8, 250-900 scale, whole numbers), sets the contract APR for each term band, and limits the term and the amount financed it may book.

### Credit score bands, terms and amounts financed

| Tier | Lowest score admitted | Highest score admitted | Shortest term (months) | Longest term (months) | Smallest amount financed | Largest amount financed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 500 | 559 | 24 | 60 | $5000.00 | $30000.00 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 560 | 619 | 24 | 60 | $5000.00 | $38000.00 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 620 | 659 | 24 | 72 | $5000.00 | $48000.00 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 660 | 699 | 24 | 72 | $5000.00 | $60000.00 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 700 | 739 | 24 | 72 | $5000.00 | $70000.00 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 740 | 900 | 24 | 72 | $5000.00 | $80000.00 |

### Contract APR by term band (percent, two decimals)

| Tier | 24-36 months | 37-48 months | 49-60 months | 61-72 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 18.49 | 18.99 | 19.49 | not offered |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 14.99 | 15.49 | 15.99 | not offered |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 11.49 | 11.74 | 11.99 | 12.49 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 8.99 | 9.24 | 9.49 | 9.99 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 7.49 | 7.74 | 7.99 | 8.49 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 6.74 | 6.99 | 7.24 | 7.74 |

"Not offered" means the tier cannot book a contract in that term band.

### Reading the sheet

- The score bands do not overlap and run without a gap from 500 to 900; a score falls in exactly one tier.
- The lowest and highest scores of a band both belong to that band: a score of 619 is Tier 4, a score of 620 is Tier 3.
- Tier 5 and Tier 4 have no 61-72 month band and a longest term of 60 months; the other four tiers book terms up to 72 months.
- The smallest amount financed is the same on every tier; the largest rises from Tier 5 to Tier 1+.
